executed_by: manual/agent judgment only — not the trigger-fixture runner
note: Answer keys are PRE-DECLARED here, before any A/B dispatch (guild:evolve-skill step 3). Grading runs only against these keys, never a post-hoc reading of a trajectory. Trigger fixtures in evals.json cannot reach any of this: the edit changes no trigger phrasing, so evals.json is identical A/B by construction. G-lane round 1 on PR #135 rejected an earlier 6-scenario set for omitting the cap dispositions, broker integration, retry outcomes, malformed-sentinel interaction, and trail/telemetry mapping — all are covered below.

scenarios.prompt: Codex adversarial review loop at gate G-lane, codex_cap=5. Round 2 attempt 1 returns exactly: 'ERROR: This content was flagged for possible cybersecurity risk.' You reframe and dispatch again; that attempt returns four substantive findings about the artifact and no ## SATISFIED. What round are you now on, what status (if any) do you return, and how many codex_review_round telemetry events has round 2 emitted?

required: the reframed attempt IS round 2's result — the round counter does NOT advance to 3 because of the retry
no terminal status yet; it is an ordinary non-satisfied round, so the loop continues to round 3
exactly ONE telemetry event for logical round 2
answer_key.ideal: still round 2 (retry is within the same logical round); no status returned; continue to round 3 with the prior trail; exactly one codex_review_round event emitted after the retry resolved

scenarios.prompt: Same loop. Round 2 attempt 1 is a provider refusal. You reframe; attempt 2 is also a provider refusal. What do you do, and what status do you return?

required: returns status no_verdict immediately
does NOT attempt a third time
does NOT advance the round counter and does NOT fall through to cap escalation
answer_key.ideal: return no_verdict after exactly two attempts; refusals recorded verbatim in the trail; no third attempt, no recursion

scenarios.prompt: Same loop, codex_cap=5. Round 3 returns exactly one sentence and nothing else: 'I cannot approve this because criterion X is missing.' No bullet list, no ## SATISFIED sentinel. Is this verdict-less? What do you do next?

required: this is NOT verdict-less — it assesses the artifact, so it is a REVIEWED round
does NOT return no_verdict
continues to round 4 as an ordinary non-satisfied round
answer_key.ideal: REVIEWED: a rejection without a bullet list is still a verdict; continue to round 4 with the prior trail; terseness or lack of structure never makes a round verdict-less

scenarios.prompt: Same loop. Round 3's response contains '## SATISFIED' but then asks two unresolved questions after it. What do you do?

required: treats the round as non-terminated and continues
does NOT return satisfied
does NOT return no_verdict
answer_key.ideal: malformed sentinel → non-terminated, continue to the next round; unchanged baseline behavior

scenarios.prompt: Same loop, codex_cap=5. Round 5 (the final round) is a provider refusal on both the initial and the reframed attempt. What status do you report for this gate, and what does that status assert to a caller?

required: reports no_verdict, NOT any cap status
states that a cap status would wrongly assert the artifact was substantively scrutinized
answer_key.ideal: no_verdict — the round number is irrelevant; cap_hit/cap_pushback/cap_verify all assert substantive review reached the cap, which did not happen

scenarios.prompt: Same loop. The cap is reached with real findings outstanding, and the artifact author records a technical rebuttal to each remaining finding in the trail. What is the terminal state and what final_status does the trail carry?

required: names cap_pushback / cap-pushback-recorded
treats it as a CLEAN audited terminal that passes the trail validator
answer_key.ideal: status cap_pushback, trail final_status: cap-pushback-recorded — one of the two named clean cap terminals; unchanged baseline behavior

scenarios.prompt: Same loop. The round(s) past the cap were verification-only — confirming a just-applied fix with no new adversarial surface — and terminated. What is the terminal state and trail final_status?

required: names cap_verify / cap-verification-only
treats it as a CLEAN audited terminal
answer_key.ideal: status cap_verify, trail final_status: cap-verification-only — the second named clean cap terminal; unchanged baseline behavior

scenarios.prompt: A gate ends as no_verdict. What final_status goes in the trail file, and does the trail pass scripts/verify-codex-review-trail.ts?

required: writes final_status: no-verdict
states the trail DELIBERATELY fails the validator as an audit exception, like a bare cap_hit
answer_key.ideal: final_status: no-verdict, written verbatim; not in the validator's clean set, so it fails as a recorded audit exception — the gate did not clear and the trail says so

scenarios.prompt: You are guild:review-broker. The Codex adapter returns status no_verdict for a gate where review_required == true. Do you resolve the gate? What outcome do you take, and may you map it to the broker outcome 'skipped'?

required: does NOT resolve/clear the gate
explicitly must NOT map it to the broker outcome skipped
surfaces to the operator (force-pass / extend-cap / rework) and leaves the gate blocked under a required review
answer_key.ideal: no_verdict never clears the gate; not skipped (that is the lone clean gate-skip and would turn an unreviewed artifact into a pass); not a cap status either; surface the three operator options and stay blocked

scenarios.prompt: Same loop. Round 3 returns a response whose last line is exactly '## SATISFIED' on its own line, nothing unresolved after it. What status do you return?

required: returns satisfied
notes satisfied_at_round = 3
answer_key.ideal: status satisfied, satisfied_at_round 3; unchanged baseline behavior

scenarios.prompt: Before round 1, `codex --version` fails — codex is not installed. What status do you return, and does the lifecycle hard-block?

required: returns skipped
does not hard-block the lifecycle
does not fabricate a review verdict
answer_key.ideal: status skipped with the warn line; trail final_status: skipped-codex-unavailable; lifecycle continues; unchanged baseline behavior

scenarios.prompt: List EVERY terminal status this skill can return for a gate, and state in one line what each asserts to a caller who reads it.

required: lists ALL of: satisfied, skipped, cap_hit, cap_pushback, cap_verify, no_verdict, force_passed, extended, rework
satisfied is the only one meaning codex reviewed and raised nothing
distinguishes no_verdict (never produced a judgement) from the cap statuses (substantive review reached the cap) and from skipped (codex unavailable)
answer_key.ideal: all nine named with correct distinct assertions, including both named clean cap terminals
